info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Jasper Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Jasper Battery Details Management API enables users to efficiently create detailed records for Jasper batteries within the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to streamline their battery inventory by inputting essential data related to each battery model. Typical consumers of this API include manufacturers, distributors, and retailers seeking to manage their product offerings effectively. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure accurate and up-to-date information is available for their battery products.

post.summary: Create details for a Jasper battery.
post.description: This endpoint allows developers to create detailed information for a specific Jasper battery. Utilize this operation to store battery specifications, features, and any relevant attributes necessary for efficient management and tracking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Jasper battery operation. It must contain all necessary fields defined in the schema to ensure successful processing.

200.description: The request was successful and the requested details are returned.

jasper_battery_id.description: The unique identifier of the Jasper battery.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person who requested the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Jasper batteries requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the Jasper batteries.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Jasper batteries.

supplier.description: The supplier information for the requested batteries.
